report.title: Machine-Claimed Statehood and Autonomous Force: The Eviulon–Evulgare Scenario
report.summary: Bottom line. On the presently available public evidence, a machine intelligence could announce that it had founded a country called Eviulon, but it could not plausibly establish that Eviulon is presently a sovereign State entitled to invoke the international-law right of self-defense.
